source.label: Vector factory feature operation and scoring

strategy.overview: Clear the left Defender drops from left to right to open the left ramp, then shoot the ramp to lock a ball. Complete H-Y-P-E from left to right to start two-ball Multiball with one lock. For the larger start, lock a second ball and complete H-Y-P-E in order; a third physical lock starts four-ball Multiball immediately. During Multiball, another ordered H-Y-P-E completion scores the built HYPE bonus at 2x or 3x.
strategy.simpleOverview: Clear the left Defender drops from left to right, shoot the opened left ramp to lock a ball, then complete H-Y-P-E from left to right to start Multiball. Lock two balls before H-Y-P-E for three-ball play, or take a third lock to start four-ball Multiball immediately.
strategy.summary: Clear the Defender bank in order, lock at the left ramp, and complete H-Y-P-E in order. One lock starts two-ball Multiball; two locks start three-ball; the third lock starts four-ball immediately.

quickInfo.name: Open the Ramp
quickInfo.summary: Clear the left Defender drops from left to right.

quickInfo.name: Lock Balls
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left ramp once it opens.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete H-Y-P-E from left to right.

quickInfo.name: Cash HYPE
quickInfo.summary: Repeat ordered H-Y-P-E during Multiball for 2x or 3x.

steps.text: Hit the left Defender drops from left to right; out-of-order hits restore the earlier row and delay the ramp opening.
Shoot the opened left ramp to lock one ball, then repeat the Defender route if you want a second lock.
Complete H-Y-P-E from left to right: one lock starts two-ball Multiball, while two locks start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, complete H-Y-P-E in order again to score the built HYPE bonus at its active multiplier.

alternatives.title: Start four-ball Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when two balls are already locked and the Defender route remains controlled.

steps.text: Open the ramp again and take the third lock; it starts four-ball Multiball immediately.
Add 3,000 to the held HYPE bonus with each H-Y-P-E target hit.
Preserve the ordered completion for Multiball, where the collect can be doubled or tripled.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, lock memory, Extra Ball and Special conversions, and whether locked balls are physically present.
Test both Defender rows, left ramp and lock releases, all H-Y-P-E targets, X-Y-Z drops and return lanes, and all four balls.

cautions.issue: Out-of-order Defender or H-Y-P-E hits do not complete their ordered sequence.
cautions.response: Read the active lamps and shoot the next required target instead of spraying the bank.
